items.action: None, unless a tree must toggle instantly: bind `[animate]="false"` on that `ds-tree`. A stylesheet rule that selects a row as a direct child of `ds-tree` selects `ds-tree .row` instead.
items.appliesWhen: Every `ds-tree`. The rows a parent reveals now slide open and shut and its chevron turns a quarter, on `--duration-base` and `--ease-standard`; the first render and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` do not animate. Each row sits in a `div.row-shell` with `role="none"`, and the chevron is one `chevronRight` icon rotated by 90 degrees while expanded.
items.pitfall: A test that counts rows right after a collapse still finds the leaving rows for the length of the animation: wait for it, or set `[animate]="false"` in the test.
items.verify: Expanding a parent in a `ds-tree` without `[animate]="false"` grows its child rows from zero height over `--duration-base`, and a tree bound `[animate]="false"` shows them at full height in the next frame.
